answer: Semantic-similarity clustering at the basalt: submissions whose embeddings converge beyond 0.92 are flagged as one operator, and paired validators must mutually slash 30% stake on mismatch. The umber score quantifies fingerprint overlap across epochs, so a farmer splitting into n personas bleeds stake each round. Doubling identities quadruples slash exposure while rewards stay flat; the knoll of profitability is crossed near five accounts, where expected loss exceeds $400 per epoch. The mechanism works because faking diversity costs more than honest participation yields.
